title: Rename a Folder of Files in One Run
description: A real isolated before-and-after run renames matching files while leaving an unrelated note untouched.
hook: Three chaotic filenames become an ordered set in one run.

scenes.headline: BEFORE. AFTER. DONE.
scenes.narration: These messy names become a numbered set in one real run. The result comes first.
scenes.caption: Three files, renamed together.

scenes.headline: THE BEFORE FOLDER
scenes.narration: The isolated folder has three camera-style names, plus notes dot text, which must stay untouched.
scenes.caption: Only matching files should change.

scenes.headline: RUN THE RENAME RULE
scenes.narration: The script matches only IMG files, then numbers them in order. The captured process reports success.
scenes.caption: Match narrowly. Rename predictably.

scenes.headline: ORDER, WITHOUT CLICKING
scenes.narration: The three targets changed. Notes dot text did not. Repetitive clicking has been reassigned to software.
scenes.caption: The unrelated file remains.
